summary: But really you can build a webpage on a piece of paper. Just think it is a new kind of text structure we need to teach. Even if folks don't want a website I would love for them to be able to view source and know what's happening. Ignorance never good.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
But really you can build a webpage on a piece of paper.
Just think it is a new kind of text structure we need to teach.

Even if folks don't want a website I would love for them to be able to view source and know what's happening.

Ignorance never good.
